title: Indeclinable
summary: INDECLI'NABLE, adjective [Latin indeclinabilis; in and declino.] Not declinable; not varied by terminations; as, pondo, in Latin, is an indeclinable noun.

inlines.v: INDECLI'NABLE, adjective [Latin indeclinabilis; in and declino.] Not declinable; not varied by terminations; as, pondo, in Latin, is an indeclinable noun.
